_comment: Map E of the brief 'maps for the Antebellum South lecture' (2026-11-16): where free Black Americans lived in 1860. The fills are the slavery tracker's (free state, slave state, territories; TEST ROWS); the numbers are the 1860 census's counts of free Black people in the ten states with the most (U.S. Census Bureau, Working Paper No. 56). 1 June 1860 is Census Day.
title: Free Black population, 1860
